Results.ReviewText: This grill sears and cooks as expected for a Weber grill but the stainless steel warming rack and the stainless steel collapsable side tables started rusting within days after assembling.  The stainless used on the side tables on this Spirit II E-210 grill is definitely lower grade than what is used on the Genesis model.  I also have the Genesis II, 4 burner model with similarly designed stainless steel collapsable side tables; my Genesis is nearly 2 years old and shows no visible rusting.  Additionally, aesthetically, the Spirit II, E-210 is a bit too minimalist. I live in a high humidity climate and like the fact that there is no cabinet below the main body of the grill.  However, it would be nice if they incorporated a "side-shield" (not sure what it is actually called) to visually hide the tank from view, similar to what is included on the Spirit I and Genesis models.  Unfortunately, I anticipate that this will not last more than 12 to 18 months, at most.
Results.Title: Decent grill but not great.

Results.ReviewText: It came assembled by the store for no additional fee (Mileage Master, Rochester, NY) and has nice features for the price.It's a pleasure to use. At last someone figured out that you can use weight as a gauge for the gas tank; nice feature! It heats up quickly, has plenty of heat in freezing temperatures, is easy to clean, has sturdy shelves, moves around easily, and starts instantly. The only slight negative is the surface appears to heat a bit unevenly, unlike the Weber Q model it replaced.That can be a good thing for food that need to cook at different temperatures, just haven't figured out the hot and cool spots yet. Don't know about durability, only used it a few times. If it's like past Weber products, it should have a very long lifespan. Last one was 15 years old. The led light that turns on automatically when the top opens is well worth it if you BBQ at night.

Results.ReviewText: Two things. good and bad.   Assembly was great. the instructions were though and explained everything very well and easy to follow.   completed in less then 30 min. looks great. Your packing engineer needs a Raise. you got all those pieces in that smallish box, packed very well so no damage could take place.  However, and I have not had a chance to call customer service yet. but the burner does not burn very high for some reason. I have a newly filled LP tank on it but the flame is barely a flicker and has trouble maintaining 200 degrees F. when ambient temps are about freezing (32f).  This unit E-210 is to be used at our cabin.  The E-310 we have at home works extremely well even through the winter months -10f and below.
Results.Title: Mixed at this point.

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
